method: built-in browser on http://127.0.0.1:8765/top10_5min_equity_curves.html<url>; wait until getEligibleModels() total series length is unchanged for 3 s; payload = JSON.stringify(getEligibleModels().map(m => ({model: m.model, series: m.series.map(p => [p.time, p.net, p.buy, p.sell, p.alt_net ?? null, p.open ?? null, p.trades ?? null])}))); sha256 over its UTF-8 bytes (crypto.subtle).
engine_side: tests/test_golden_sets.py builds the same payload from Engine.eligible() (integral floats printed as integers, compact separators) and compares the sha256 and the byte length.

sets.note: the page opens a past date in selected-time mode (top 1 as of the head time), so it shows 1 model, not the scenario's 10
